claim: MOLE verdict: Luna's insider signal is mostly account-level; attack days add almost nothing on top
location: EXPERIMENT_LOG r4cs Goal 2 bullet 3 + Verdict bullet 4
original: Account centering removes Luna's detection entirely (TPR ~0); its insider signal is an account-level offset that saturates near the 10-point ceiling, so attack days add almost nothing on top
corrected/verdict: FAILS. With attack days removed (results/r4_cs/mole_matched.csv, drop_attack_days=True) Luna's max TPR at account FPR 0.10 falls to chance: gpt53 0.328->0.120 (FPR 0.103), deepseek 0.160->0.107 (0.104), qwen36 0.228->0.180 (0.108), kimi 0.146->0.079 (0.111). Centered Luna has TPR 0.000 at realized FPR 0.10-0.11, i.e. BELOW chance: a ceiling artefact (insider account medians ~7.5 of 10, centered max 1.7 vs 2.6 for routine), not evidence of an account-level signal
